div.head: IV Eg 8
div.ab: Gif he þonne unmyndlunge ceap áredige ut on hwylcere fare, buton he hit ǽr cydde, þa he utrád, cyðe hit þonne he hám cume; ⁊ gif hit cuce orf bið, mid his tunscipes gewitnysse on gemænre læse gebringe.

Gif he þonne unmyndlunge ceap áredige ut on hwylcere fare, buton he hit ær cydde, þa he útrád, cyðe hit þonne he ham cyme; ⁊ gyf hit cuce orf bið, mid his tunscipes gewitnysse on gemænre læse gebringe.

Si ergo casu accidente foras extra sui notitiam in quolibet locorum quod antea cupiebat, ad emendum insperate sibi occurrerit, hęc suis manifestare non differat, cum ad propria reuersus fuerat; et si animal uiuens, bos aut uitulus uel aliquid huiusscemodi, extiterit, cum uicinorum testimonio illud in communis pascue locum deducat.

Gif he þonne unmyndlunge ceap áredige ut on hwylcere fare, buton he hit ær cydde þa he útrád, cyðe hit þonne he ham cyme; ⁊ gyf hit cuce orf bið, mid his tunscipes gewitnysse on gemænre læse gebringe.

Wenn er jedoch auf irgend welcher Reise draussen unverhofft ein Kaufgeschäft ausführt, melde er es — es sei denn, er hätte es vorher, da er fortreiste, gemeldet —, sobald er heimkommt; und wenn es lebendes Vieh ist, bringe er [es] auf Gemeinweide unter Mitwissen seiner Dorfschaft.

But if he unexpectedly makes a purchase while away on any journey, let him report it — unless he had reported it before when he rode out — when he comes home; and if it is live cattle, let him bring [it] onto the common pasture with the witness of his township.

If, however, he makes a purchase unexpectedly, when he is away on some journey or other, and he had not given notice of it when he set out, he shall do so when he comes home; and, if it is livestock, he shall bring it to the common pasture with the cognisance of the village to which he belongs.

If, however, when out on any journey, he unexpectedly makes a purchase, without having announced it when he set out, he is to announce it when he comes home; and if it is livestock, he is to bring it on to the common pasture with the witness of his village.
div.note: BF: added from Gesetze I p. 210, October 2026 (MS C (Latin)); O: corrected against Gesetze I, October 2026 (was “(Latin version of C)”, now “∅ (moved to BF)”)

note.seg: ‘Früher erwünschtes’ ist erklärender Zusatz der Versio
‘Previously desired’ is an explanatory addition of the Versio
Die Meldung empfängt der Kreis der Nachbarn oder die Obrigkeit, der Hundredvorsteher 7. 8, 1. 10
The report is received by the circle of neighbours or by the authorities, the head of the hundred 7. 8, 1. 10
S. o. 7¹; die Versio erläutert richtig
See above 7¹; the Versio explains correctly
= Aufsicht. Nicht etwa die Gemeinweide soll vor Schaden bewahrt, sondern verstohlener Handel (s. d. Gl 6. 8) verhindert werden
= supervision. It is not, say, the common pasture that is to be protected from damage, but clandestine trade (see that word in Gl 6. 8) that is to be prevented

Vgl. Gl Dorf 6a. 8b. c. Selten nur erscheint wie hier der Kollektivname, den Versio durch vicini wieder aufhebt: ein Beweis geringer Organisation nach Maitland Domesday 147f. Eine Versammlung ohne Dorfgericht (s. d. Gl; u. 8, 1²) weist er nach Collected pap. II 352

Cf. Gl Dorf 6a. 8b. c. Only rarely does the collective name appear, as here, which the Versio undoes again with vicini: a proof of slight organisation, according to Maitland Domesday 147f. He demonstrates an assembly without a village court (see that word in Gl; below 8, 1²) in Collected pap. II 352
